title: Florida Man Tried Killing Girlfriend Before Going Full GTA: Cops
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Florida man going “full GTA mode” after allegedly trying to kill his girlfriend. Authorities said Armando Lopez allegedly stole a cop car while fleeing from police and racked up a slew of criminal charges. Watch the wild incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
